name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先查分布再谈相关，给每个信号发判决书
tagline_zh: 建模前先过一道诚实审计：分布形状、厚尾处理、样本量下限，再用 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/F…
tagline_en: Pre-model honesty check: distributions, heavy tails, sample floors, then a CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE verdict.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 不给你相关系数就完事。它把每个信号拆成可复现的迷你检验，用判决式结论逼你直面数据。
why_en: It refuses to hand you a correlation and walk away. Each signal becomes a reproducible mini-test with a verdict, forcing you to.
limit_zh: 只做单变量与两两关系的描述性审计，不做多变量因果推断；需要你已有明确假设或待验信念，否则它只会输出一堆分布图。
limit_en: Descriptive single/pairwise audit only, no multivariate causal inference. Needs a prior belief or hypothesis to test; otherwise it just emits.
title_en: Signal auditor that issues verdicts before you model
